query: Consider Sony Pictures Television's Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document mention whether or not the Receiving Party is allowed to reverse engineer any objects which embody the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information?
gold:
Each party, as a Receiving Party, agrees that it will:
(e) not decompile, disassemble or reverse engineer all or any part of such Confidential Information.
rag_answer:
Yes. Section 3(e) of the Sony Pictures Television NDA states that the Receiving Party agrees **not to decompile, disassemble, or reverse engineer all or any part of the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information**.

The document does not expressly use the phrase “objects which embody” the Confidential Information, but it clearly prohibits reverse engineering of any part of the Confidential Information itself.

judge.gold_summary: 接收方不得对披露方的保密信息进行反编译、拆解或逆向工程。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答指出 NDA 规定接收方不得对保密信息的任何部分进行反编译、拆解或逆向工程，并说明文档未明确使用“objects which embody”措辞。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标的关键结论，即明确禁止接收方逆向工程保密信息；虽补充说明未使用“objects which embody”的表述，但不影响命中金标要点。
